title: `ProjectSettings.globalize_path()` doesn't strip `custom_user_dir` slash when returning path
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.1 and 4.5.beta6

### System information

Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition)

### Issue description

If the project setting `application/config/custom_user_dir_name` ends with a `/`, `OS.get_user_data_dir()` will work correctly and return `/home/user/.local/share/custom_name/` but `ProjectSettings.globalize_path("user://")` will return `/home/user/.local/share/custom_name//`.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new project and run this twice. Though I imagine this is more hassle than just glancing at https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/core/config/project_settings.cpp#L254
```GDScript
extends Node


func _ready() -> void:
	if _set_settings():
		print(ProjectSettings.globalize_path("user://"))
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.25).timeout
		_cleanup()


func _set_settings() -> bool:
	if not ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/custom_user_dir_name"):
		var dir_name: String = "%s/" % Time.get_datetime_string_from_system().md5_text()
		var cfg = ConfigFile.new()
		cfg.set_value("application", "config/use_custom_user_dir", true)
		cfg.set_value("application", "config/custom_user_dir_name", dir_name)
		cfg.save("res://override.cfg")
		get_tree().quit.call_deferred()
		return false
	return true


func _cleanup() -> void:
	OS.move_to_trash(OS.get_user_data_dir())
	get_tree().quit.call_deferred()
```
